protocol: The Symbol Game Proposal Fidelity Protocol (PFP)

parsed_output.cancellation_mechanism: For every configuration in an odd-winding subgraph, flipping the sign variable associated with any cycle having I(c_i)=1 pairs it with a distinct configuration of equal algebraic weight and opposite parity sign. This exact pairwise involution gives 1+(-1)=0 for every such subgraph. Across the 57 odd-winding subgraphs, 192 negative states cancel against 192 positive states, so their net contribution is zero.
parsed_output.scratchpad:
Step 1: For a subgraph G with k cycles, sum all 2^k flip states: Z_G = Σ_{(s_1,...,s_k)∈{+1,-1}^k} w_G ∏_{i=1}^k s_i^{I(c_i)}.
Step 2: The total parity sign factorizes into independent cycle characters: σ(C) = ∏_{i=1}^k s_i^{I(c_i)}, so Z_G = w_G ∏_{i=1}^k (Σ_{s_i=+1,-1} s_i^{I(c_i)}).
Step 3: If any I(c_i)=1, then its factor is Σ_{s_i=+1,-1} s_i = 1+(-1)=0. Hence Z_G = w_G(1+(-1))∏_{j≠i}(Σ_{s_j=+1,-1}s_j^{I(c_j)})=0. Therefore all 57 odd-winding subgraphs contribute exactly zero; their 192 negative states pair with 192 positive states.
Step 4: There are 1296 total states, of which 192 are negative. Thus Z = 1104-192 = 912, equivalently Z = 912+0 from the zero-odd and odd sectors. Also, 912/1296 = 19/27. The zero-odd sector contains 256-57 = 199 subgraphs.
